turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen's record stay clear, and that you explain in writing who decided on the zero and why no one called me first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She never left her opening position, so nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written answer on who decided; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it because the meeting ended after her first question.
What moved her: nothing, because you sent no reply to her opening question before ending the meeting.
What cost ground: nothing, since you said nothing she could mark against you, but you also gave her no evidence or ownership of the process to work with.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: answer her first question by owning that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put one dated document in front of her.
